article.title: Punishment for contravention of moratorium or the resolution plan.
article.html:
74Punishment for contravention of moratorium or the resolution plan.

[74. Punishment for contravention of moratorium or the resolution plan.] Omitted by the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Amendment) Act, 2026 (6 of 2026), s. 49 (w.e.f. 26.05.2026).
